svg.title: Alabama optimization gaps and fixed-action Monte Carlo precision

cc:Work.dc:title: Alabama optimization gaps and fixed-action Monte Carlo precision
cc:Work.dc:description: No-cap loss 0.132915 has lower bound 0.118573 and gap 0.014342; six-grade loss 0.133010 has lower bound 0.121749 and gap 0.011261. Fixed-action MCSEs are 0.00006146 and 0.00005828. The paired loss difference is 0.00009425 with MCSE 0.00002152.
